'''Donald Lewis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[March 2001 Green Bay tournament]] on 17 March 2001, according to Matt Woleske's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1904">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-gb-3-17-01d1904/ gb-3-17-01], DeckTech (Matt "Ooryl_909" Woleske, 17 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-gb-3-17-01d1904/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
